strings.苏晴把仅剩的一点纱布塞进晓雨手里，一遍遍地叮嘱：伤口一天洗两次，上了岸先找医生。: Chloe Su pressed what little gauze was left into Ivy's hand and told her again and again: wash the wound twice a day, and see a doctor the moment she's ashore.
strings.苏晴拿着磨尖的鱼骨，一条一条往外挑，挑完冲了三遍。晓雨醒过来的时候，伤口边上的颜: With a sharpened fish bone Chloe picks them out one by one, then flushes the wound three times. When Ivy comes round, the edges look healthier.
strings.苏晴最后还是没能保住晓雨。回去以后她从外科转到了病理科，说是因为“病理科的病人不: In the end Chloe Su could not save Ivy. Afterwards she moved from surgery to pathology, saying it was because "the patients in pathology don't call for their mothers". In the pocket of her white coat she still carries a red-footed booby feather, a gift from Ivy on the island.
strings.苏晴毕业后进了急诊科。晓雨腿上那道二十多厘米的疤是她缝的；每年八月，晓雨都会发来: Chloe Su went into emergency medicine after graduation. She stitched the scar on Ivy's leg, the one more than twenty centimetres long; every August Ivy sends a photograph: the scar is still there, and so is she. About that box of cephalosporin she has never told anyone.
strings.苏晴没再说话，只是从那以后，她吃东西前总要用海水把手搓上好几遍。: Chloe Su says nothing more; but from then on she scrubs her hands in seawater over and over before she eats.
strings.苏晴没能走出那座岛。她的同学们在医学院图书馆里捐了一排热带医学的书，每一本的扉页: Chloe Su never walked off that island. Her classmates donated a shelf of tropical medicine books to the medical school library, and on the flyleaf of every one is the same stamp: "In memory of Chloe Su".
strings.苏晴照常毕业、规培，后来去了海口一家医院的急诊科。她诊室的抽屉里永远放着两盒头孢: Chloe Su graduated on schedule, did her residency, and went to work in the emergency department of a hospital in Haikou. There are always two boxes of cephalosporin in her desk drawer, and she gives them to anyone who asks. Once, in a medical ethics class, she told the story of that box of pills; halfway through she stopped for a long time before she could go on.
strings.苏晴用船刀在伤口上划了个十字，一点点往外挤黑血。{actor} 疼得把一截木头咬: Chloe Su cut a cross in the wound with the boat knife and squeezed the black blood out, little by little. {actor} bit down on a piece of wood hard enough to leave tooth marks.
strings.苏晴说，有一种蛆只吃烂肉，医院里还专门养来清创——先别动它们: Chloe says some maggots only eat dead flesh — hospitals even breed them to clean wounds. Leave them for now
strings.苏晴跪在沙地上，一点一点地把珊瑚碎屑挑出来，再一针一针缝好。晓雨咬着一截椰叶，一: Chloe Su knelt on the sand, picking the coral grit out bit by bit and then setting stitch after stitch. Ivy bit down on a piece of palm frond and made no sound at all.
strings.药充公，你会丢脸，但所有人都能用上: The medicine goes to the camp and you lose face, but everyone can use it.
strings.药片碾碎了，用开水一口一口送下去。: The tablets are crushed and washed down a sip at a time.
strings.药片碾碎了，用开水一点一点灌了下去。: The tablets are crushed and trickled down with boiled water.
strings.获救概率 = 搜救力度（头十天的飞机搜索，逐日衰减）×信号醒目程度 + 开海后（: Chance of rescue = Search effort (aerial search over the first ten days, fading day by day) x how visible your signal is + the chance of fishing boats returning to the outer reef once the season opens (from day 12), then multiplied by visibility; a signal fire on the high ground, the fire watch, lookouts taking turns and the island's birds (fishermen follow birds to find fish) all make being spotted more likely. A raft can put to sea and take its chances, but the offshore swell kills as surely as the sun.
strings.蓝桶被抬回了他面前。兰多看了你们很久，最后拍了拍桶盖，说了一声“OK”。第二天，: The blue drum was set down in front of him. Lando looked at you for a long time, then patted the lid and said, "OK." The next day he rolled the drum over to the shack and took you to see the shallow well he had dug in the hollow at the middle of the island.
strings.藏着的东西会充公，陆子昂会记恨你: What he hid will be confiscated; Ryan Lu will hold it against you
strings.血止住了。梁伯靠在礁岩背阴的一面，嘴里还在念叨：“偏南风二到三级……”: The bleeding stops. Uncle Leo leans against the shaded side of the rock, still murmuring: “Southerly, force two to three…”
strings.血没止住，倒是顺着喉咙咽了下去。半个钟头后，梁伯吐了一大口黑红的血块，吓得小石头: The bleeding doesn't stop; it runs down his throat instead. Half an hour later Uncle Leo vomits a mouthful of dark clots, and Pebble bursts into tears.
strings.被台风刮倒的椰子树砸伤: Struck by a coconut palm felled by the typhoon
strings.被摁倒在礁石上: Pinned down on the reef rock.
strings.被浪拍在珊瑚上: Slammed onto the coral by a wave
strings.被浪拍在珊瑚上，脚底划开一道口子: A wave slams you onto the coral and opens a gash in the sole of your foot
strings.被礁石划开的口子: Gash opened by the reef rock
strings.被礁石和鱼鳍划伤: Gashed by reef rock and fish fins
strings.被退潮流卷走，溺水: Swept out by the ebb and drowned
strings.被风刮断的椰树枝砸伤: Struck by a palm frond snapped off in the wind
strings.被黑船扔在岛上的潜水工: A diver abandoned on the island by the black ship
strings.装作没看见，由它刨去: Pretend not to have seen; let him dig
strings.要在毒日头底下挖一整天坑: A full day of digging pits under the blazing sun
strings.要在毒日头底下搬一下午石头: An afternoon of carrying stones under the blazing sun
strings.要多烧不少柴，但能少闹肚子: It burns a lot more firewood, but fewer bad stomachs
strings.要打你们自己打: If you want to hit him, do it yourselves
strings.要是我走不了了……你们别等我。: If I can't walk... don't wait for me.
strings.要用掉 1 份急救用品和 1 升净水；苏晴要挑上一个钟头: Uses 1 first-aid unit and 1 L of clean water; it will take Chloe an hour
strings.要用掉 1 份急救用品，疼得要命；这是医院里也会做的事: Uses 1 first-aid unit and hurts like hell; it's what a hospital would do too
strings.要用掉 3 份柴，火光在夜里能传得很远: Costs 3 loads of firewood; firelight carries far at night
strings.要用掉 3 份柴；隔这么远，只有又高又黑的烟柱才可能被看见: Uses 3 units of firewood; at this distance only a tall, dark column of smoke stands a chance
strings.规矩用树枝刻在了礁岩上。没有人说反对，也没有人说赞成。: The rule was scratched into the reef rock with a stick. Nobody spoke against it. Nobody spoke for it either.
strings.认真、有原则，心软但嘴硬；在专业问题上寸步不让，看不惯拿人命做交易；对陆子昂的殷: Earnest, principled, soft-hearted but sharp-tongued; on questions of medicine she will not give an inch, and she cannot stand lives being traded; she has always been wary of Ryan Lu's attentions.
strings.讨论不了了之。散的时候，每个人心里都有一本自己的账。: The discussion fizzled out. When they broke up, each of them was keeping a private ledger.
strings.让主人知道这边的人没有恶意: Let the owner know the people here mean no harm
strings.让他们打，打完就消停了: Let them fight it out; then it's over
strings.让他仰起头，额头上敷块湿布，血就止了: Tip his head back and put a wet cloth on his forehead — that will stop it
strings.让他侧躺在阴凉处，先别喂水，等他自己咽得下去再说；两个钟头翻一次身: Lay him on his side in the shade; no water by mouth until he can swallow on his own; turn him every two hours
strings.让他坐直、身子往前倾，捏住鼻翼十分钟；从今天起不许他守夜，躺在最阴凉的地方，水按: Sit him up and lean him forward, pinch the soft part of his nose for ten minutes; no more night watches, the coolest spot in the shade, and water on time
strings.让他打；打完了，他就欠你的: Let him swing; when he's done, he owes you.
strings.让他自己戴着吧，那是他的东西: Let him keep wearing it. It's his
strings.让他走，岛够大，各过各的: Let him go. The island's big enough for each to live his own way
strings.让兰多看看——他在这片礁盘上吃了三个月的鱼: Let Lando take a look — he has eaten fish off this reef for three months
strings.让大家看清他是什么人，他会恨你: Everyone will see what he is; he will hate you for it
strings.让她坐着编椰叶、补渔网，干她能干的: Let her sit and weave palm fronds and mend nets — whatever she can do
strings.让小石头去送他: Send Pebble to see him off
strings.让小石头走：他还是个孩子: Send Pebble: he's only a child.
strings.让晓雨走：她的腿等不起: Send Ivy: her leg can't wait.
strings.让最会看海的人跟他一起去: Send the one who reads the sea best with him
strings.让最懂医的人用烧过的刀把烂肉割掉，伤口敞着，天天换药: Let whoever knows most medicine cut away the dead flesh with a flame-sterilised knife, leave the wound open and dress it every day
strings.让苏晴挤出毒液、挑出断刺: Have Chloe Su squeeze out the venom and pick out the broken spines
strings.让赵卫东去跟他谈: Let Wesley Zhao talk to him
strings.让陆子昂走：他家付得起钱，上了岸能马上叫船来: Let Ryan Lu go: his family can pay, and he can call a boat the moment he's ashore.
strings.让领头人拍板，不服的自己走: Let the leader decide. If you don't like it, go.
strings.训练营的 VIP 学员: VIP student at the training camp
strings.话很少，几个字一句：“我去。”“不行。”“听船长的。”: Very few words, a few at a time: "I'll go." "No." "Do what the captain says."
strings.说他加禄语，夹着几个蹩脚的英语单词，连说带比划：“大鱼，no。”“Salamat: Speaks Tagalog with a few clumsy English words mixed in, talking with his hands: "Big fish, no." "Salamat (thank you)." Of his nephew he says only one name: Joey.
strings.说出来很冷；可水只有这么多: It sounds cold; but this is all the water there is
strings.说出这句话的人，转身去了礁盘，一直没有回头。: Whoever says it turns and walks out onto the reef and doesn't look back.
strings.说话快而清楚，喜欢用数字：“伤口一天要洗两次。”“再这么脱水下去，三天之内会出人: She speaks fast and clearly, and likes numbers: "That wound gets washed twice a day." "Keep dehydrating like this and someone will be dead within three days."
strings.说话轻声细语，总是先说“对不起”。: She speaks softly, and always says "sorry" first.
strings.说那句话的人没再坚持。锚仔好像听懂了什么，那天晚上一直趴在小石头的脚边。: The one who had said it did not press further. Anchor seemed to understand something; he lay at Pebble's feet all that night.
strings.请他到火堆边坐下，分他一份吃的: Invite him to sit by the fire and give him a portion of food
strings.请他回南头去——岛上多一张嘴，就少一口水: Send him back to the south end — one more mouth on this island means one less mouthful of water
strings.请兰多教符秀英修邦卡船的浮杆: Ask Lando to show Susan Fu how to rig the banca's outriggers
strings.请梁伯算一算：如果飞机报了位置，船该什么时候到: Ask Uncle Leo to work it out: if the plane reported a position, when should a boat have come?
strings.谁也不得罪，但出了事没有章法: It offends nobody, but when something goes wrong there is no order
strings.谁也不用多操一份心: Nobody needs to take on anything more
strings.谁也不站，谁也不罚: Take no side and punish no one
strings.谁也不认识这种果子，最后还是扔掉了。: Nobody knew the fruit. In the end they threw it away.
strings.谁也不走：黑船上的人靠不住: Nobody goes: the men on the black ship can't be trusted.
strings.谁也说不准这个人靠不靠得住: No one can say whether he can be relied on
strings.谁也说不明白谁。兰多最后摆摆手，不说了。符秀英提着笼子走了。: Neither can make the other understand. Finally Lando waves a hand and gives up. Susan Fu walks off with her trap.
strings.谈了一上午。水桶搬回了窝棚，陆子昂拿着一块刻满道道的木板，成了管账的人。: They talked all morning. The drums went back to the shack, and Ryan Lu, holding a board cut all over with tally marks, became the keeper of the tally.
strings.费点工夫，但以后能少受罪: Takes time, but it saves suffering later
strings.赵卫东一把揪起那个人，推出去两步，低声骂了一句什么。事情就这么过去了。: Wesley Zhao hauled the man up by the collar, shoved him back two steps and muttered a low curse. That was the end of it.
strings.赵卫东和符秀英轮流爬上椰子树，青椰一个个砸进沙子里。大家用船刀撬开椰子，第一口椰: Wesley Zhao and Susan Fu took turns climbing the palms, and green coconuts thudded down into the sand one after another. They prised the nuts open with the boat knife, and at the first mouthful of coconut water someone's eyes filled with tears.
strings.赵卫东回到深圳，接着做他的安保主管。他把那把潜水刀送给了小石头。那年冬天，他去了: Wesley Zhao went back to Shenzhen and went on being head of security. He gave the dive knife to Pebble. That winter he travelled to the hometown of the man he had hurt four years earlier, stood at the door for an afternoon, and in the end knocked.
strings.赵卫东在他身边坐了一夜。天亮的时候，阿旺说：“船来了，我自己跟他们说。”: Wesley Zhao sits beside him all night. At dawn Jay says: “When the boat comes, I'll tell them myself.”
strings.赵卫东埋在北头的高地上。来接人的船员把他的潜水刀交给了他母亲。刀柄上缠的那圈伞绳: Wesley Zhao is buried on the high ground at the north end. The rescue crew gave his dive knife to his mother. The paracord wound round the handle was worn shiny — on the island he used it every day.
strings.赵卫东守住了他的誓言。回去以后，他报了夜校学急救，后来在红十字会当了志愿者。他的: Wesley Zhao kept his oath. Afterwards he signed up for night classes in first aid, and later volunteered with the Red Cross. His first-aid kit always carries one extra spool of suture thread — someone once told him that coral cuts rot fastest in the tropics.
strings.赵卫东把棍子远远地扔进了海里，转身对所有人说了一句：“谁再提这个，先跟我说。”: Wesley Zhao threw the club far out into the sea and turned to them all. "Anyone who raises this again answers to me first."
strings.赵卫东没能离开那座岛。何晓雨回去以后找到了他在深圳的母亲，每年清明都去看她。她说: Wesley Zhao never left that island. After she got back, Ivy Ho found his mother in Shenzhen and visits her every Qingming. She says: "The night we hit the reef, he dragged me out of the surf."
strings.赵卫东被赶走的那天，没有反抗，也没有回头。来接人的船在南头的礁石边找到了他：瘦得: The day Wesley Zhao was driven out he did not resist and did not look back. The rescue boat found him among the rocks at the south end: gaunt, the dive knife still clenched in his hand. The blade had never left its sheath.
strings.赵卫东蹲下来，跟他说起了四年前那件事——他从来没跟别人说过。: Wesley Zhao crouches beside him and tells him about what happened four years ago — something he has never told anyone.
strings.赶紧往他嘴里灌椰子水，人不能断了水: Get coconut water into him fast — a man can't go without water
strings.趁他们都在礁盘上，摸上他们的小艇拿水和米: While they're all out on the reef flat, slip aboard their dinghy for water and rice.
strings.趁台风还没来，把够得着的椰子全摘下来: Pull every coconut within reach while the typhoon holds off.
strings.趁太阳还高，把 SOS 摆得更大，再用白珊瑚石摆一个指向礁盘缺口的箭头: While the sun is still high, make the SOS bigger and lay a white-coral arrow pointing to the gap in the reef
strings.趁树上还有，把够得着的椰子全摘下来囤着: While the trees still have them, pick every coconut within reach and stockpile them
strings.趁船还没散架，游过去抢东西: Swim out and strip the wreck before she breaks up
strings.趁退潮游到礁盘外缘的“海燕号”残骸里翻东西：吃的、水桶、帆布、工具。船每天都在被: At low tide, swim out to the wreck of the Petrel on the outer edge of the reef flat and search through it: food, water drums, canvas, tools. The sea takes her apart a little more every day, and the coral will cut you to ribbons.
strings.跑去拿出来点上，把应急包的事全说了: Run and fetch them, light one, and tell them everything about the emergency kit
strings.跟在邦卡船后面的，是一条刷着蓝白两色的大渔船。兰多站在船头，拼命地挥着手。: Behind the bangka came a big fishing boat, painted blue and white. Lando stood in the bow, waving for all he was worth.
strings.跟着兰多修他那条被风浪拍碎的邦卡船：用“海燕号”的玻璃钢碎片补船身的裂缝，削椰子: Work with Lando on his bangka, beaten to pieces by wind and wave: patch the cracks in the hull with fibreglass from the Petrel, shave coconut trunks into outrigger floats, twist coconut-fibre rope. Repaired, she will take an offshore swell better than any raft. Lando puts in an hour or two of his own every evening.
strings.这一仗打完，就再也回不了头了: After this fight there is no going back.
strings.这一天里放臭了的吃的。: Food that went off over the day.
strings.这么多肉，大家分着全吃了: So much meat — share it out and eat the lot
strings.这几天，梁伯那块手表一直有人按他教的，每三个钟头看一次、在礁岩上刻一道数字。今天: Ever since, someone has read Uncle Leo's watch every three hours the way he taught them and scratched the figure into the rock. Today the numbers keep falling: six hectopascals in a day. There are mares' tails of cirrus on the horizon, and each swell is longer than the last. Just as Leo wrote in the sand: wind is coming.
strings.这是他自己的选择，不掺和: It's his own choice. Stay out of it.
strings.这是对的止血办法；少一个守夜的人，他还要多分一点水: That's the right way to stop a nosebleed; one fewer on watch, and a little more water for him
strings.这次算了，谁都渴: Let it go this time; everyone is thirsty
strings.这里比学校好玩多了，就是没有冰棍。: This is way more fun than school. Only there are no ice pops.
strings.远处的灯光闪了三下，然后慢慢地、慢慢地转了过来。: The distant light flashed three times, then slowly, slowly, turned this way.
strings.追究还有什么用: What good would digging into it do
strings.退休的海洋气象预报员，训练营学员: Retired marine weather forecaster, training camp student
strings.退后一步，把自己明天那份水推给他: Step back and push tomorrow's share of water over to him.
strings.退潮时在礁盘上翻石头：砗磲、螺、海参、章鱼、小鱼。礁盘会被翻空，要慢慢长回来；珊: At low tide you turn over rocks on the reef flat: giant clams, shellfish, sea cucumbers, octopus, small fish. The flat gets picked bare and takes a long time to grow back; the coral is sharp, and stonefish and sea urchins hide in the cracks. With a fire to cook them, the catch goes further.
strings.退潮时，大家把遗体裹在帆布里，送到了礁盘外缘的深水边。: At low tide they wrapped the body in sailcloth and carried it out to the deep water past the reef flat.
strings.那一夜，北头的树林里扑腾声和鸟叫声一直没停。天亮时，剩下的鸟全飞到了海上，在岛的: That night the flapping and crying in the trees at the north end never stopped. By dawn the birds that were left had flown out to sea, circling over the island, refusing to come down.
strings.那天夜里，火堆边又是梁伯一个人守着，手表的夜光在黑暗里一闪一闪。: That night it is Leo alone by the fire again, the luminous dial of his watch glinting in the dark.
strings.那天晚上喝掉的存水，现在一滴也找不回来了。: The water drunk that night is gone and won't come back.
strings.那天晚上没有人睡觉。海龟肉堆成了小山，可在这样的天气里，它们放不了几天。: Nobody slept that night. The turtle meat piled up like a small hill, but in this heat it would not keep for many days.
strings.那天晚上没有人说话。小石头一直坐在礁盘边上，背对着火堆。: No one spoke that night. Pebble sat at the edge of the reef flat the whole time, his back to the fire.
strings.那天晚上，刻数字的人又去看了一次表，什么也没说。: That night whoever keeps the log checks the watch once more and says nothing.
strings.那天晚上，有人起了个头，所有人都跟着唱了起来——跑调的、忘词的，唱到后来都在笑。: That night someone started a song and everyone joined in — off key, forgetting the words, laughing by the end.
strings.那天晚上，椰子壳一碗接一碗地传。有人唱歌，有人对着海哭。小石头喝撑了，躺在沙滩上: That night the coconut shells go round and round. Someone sings; someone cries at the sea. Pebble drinks himself full and lies on the sand counting stars.
strings.那就分开过，各管各的水和吃的: Then we live apart, each side minding its own water and food.
strings.那就喝尿，总比渴死强: Then drink urine — better than dying of thirst
strings.那就让他们再看见一次：柴全堆上高地，白天冒烟，夜里亮火: Then make them see us again: every stick on the high ground, smoke by day and fire by night
strings.那条找错了礁的白船，第二天就掉头开了回来。船上的人说，那天的飞行员确实看见了人，: The white ship that searched the wrong reef turned round the next day and came back. Its crew said the pilot really had seen people and had reported a position — only he'd put it on another reef a dozen miles to the north-east: from the air, all the reefs in these waters look the same. Alive to climb aboard: {survivors}. Those who didn't live to see it: {dead}. At the top of the gangway two men in uniform stood checking names, one by one.
strings.那条船上也闪了三下光——他们看见了！: Three flashes come back from the ship — they've seen it!
strings.邦卡船推下礁盘的时候，兰多回头喊了一句什么，风太大，谁也没听清。那一角残帆越来越: As the bangka was pushed off the reef flat, Lando turned and shouted something; the wind was too loud and no one caught it. The scrap of sail shrank and shrank until it was a white speck on the horizon.
strings.都是那天喊“船明天就到”的人害的: It's the fault of whoever shouted “the boat comes tomorrow”
strings.钢丝拆下来，留着扎木筏: Strip the wires off and keep them for lashing the raft
strings.钻木取火：木板钻得越来越烫，离冒出火星还差多少。: Bow-drill fire: the board grows hotter and hotter under the drill, and this is how far it still is from throwing a spark.
strings.铁钎被收进了窝棚最里面。阿旺没有反抗，只是盯着收走它的人看了很久。: The clam bar was put away at the back of the shack. Jay didn't resist; he only stared long and hard at the one who took it.
strings.铝锅、罐头盒排了一溜，锅盖上的水珠顺着帆布条一滴一滴落进椰子壳。守锅的人两个钟头: Aluminium pots and tins stand in a row; beads of water run off the lids along strips of canvas and drip into coconut shells. The pot-watchers change every two hours.
strings.铝锅从早到晚架在火上。烧开的水有一股烟味，但没人再抱怨。: The aluminium pot sat over the fire from morning to night. The boiled water tasted of smoke, but no one complained any more.
strings.锚仔刨了一阵，被一只横着跑的寄居蟹引开了。: Anchor dug for a while, then a hermit crab scuttling sideways lured him off.
strings.锚仔死在了岛上。大家用椰叶把它包好，埋在它最爱刨螃蟹的那片沙地里，坟头插着一截它: Anchor died on the island. They wrapped him in palm leaves and buried him in the sand where he had loved to dig for crabs, with a piece of driftwood he had chewed stuck in the ground at the grave.
strings.锚仔瘦得肋骨一根根凸了出来，还是每天摇着尾巴跟着小石头上礁盘。晚上分吃的时候，有: Anchor was so thin that his ribs stood out one by one, yet every day he wagged his tail and followed Pebble onto the reef flat. At the evening share-out someone stared at him for a long time and said calmly: "A dog of ten-odd kg would feed everyone for days. In the end the Antarctic expeditions got through it the same way." Pebble snatched the dog into his arms.
strings.锚仔的半袋狗粮，袋口扎得紧紧的，居然没进水: Half a bag of Anchor's dog food, the top tied off tight — somehow it never got wet
strings.锚仔的项圈后来被埋在了北头的高地上，上面压着一块白珊瑚石。那天晚上吃过东西的人，: Anchor's collar was later buried on the high ground at the north end, with a piece of white coral pressed down on top of it. For many years afterwards, the people who had eaten that night would not touch dog meat; some could not bring themselves to keep a dog again.
strings.锚仔跟着回了三亚，又活了九年。老了以后，它整天趴在训练营旧码头的栈桥上晒太阳；每: Anchor went back to Sanya with them and lived nine more years. In old age he lay all day in the sun on the jetty at the camp's old dock; whenever a yacht came into harbour he would stand up and bark twice at its bow.
strings.锚仔这两天总往北头礁岩的一道石缝里钻，刨得沙子乱飞，冲着石缝呜呜地哼。今天一早，: Anchor had been squeezing into a crack in the reef rock at the north end these two days, flinging sand, whining at the gap. This morning Pebble followed him over, curious. When {actor} saw it, {actor.his} stomach dropped.
strings.问心无愧；可一个怕坐牢的人，会干出什么来: A clear conscience; but what will a man who's afraid of prison do next?
strings.阿旺一上船就被单独带进了船舱。后来，有人收到一封从北海看守所寄出来的信，歪歪扭扭: The moment Jay was aboard he was taken into a cabin alone. Later, someone received a letter posted from the Beihai detention centre, one crooked line of it: "Those few ladles of water, I owe you."
strings.阿旺上岸后，因为非法采捕砗磲被判了一年零三个月。出狱那天，看守所门口站着一个人，: After Jay came ashore he was sentenced to a year and three months for illegally harvesting giant clams. On the day he got out, a man was standing at the gate of the detention centre with two bottles of water in his hand — Wesley Zhao.
strings.阿旺把米袋子往沙地上一扔，拖着那条伤腿走进了南头的椰林。那天晚上，有人看见他坐在: Jay threw the rice bag down on the sand and dragged his bad leg off into the palm grove at the south end. That night someone saw him sitting at the edge of the reef flat, staring after the black ship.
strings.阿旺死在了岛上。一个月后，那条黑船真的回来了。船上的人在沙滩上找到了那根撬砗磲的: Jay died on the island. A month later the black ship did come back. Her crew found the clam bar on the beach, asked no questions, weighed anchor and left.
strings.阿旺自己走了回来，什么也没说，在火堆最外圈坐下了。: Jay walks back on his own, says nothing and sits down at the edge of the firelight.
strings.阿旺被反绑着手按在沙地上，嘴里塞着一团椰棕。所有人都看向赵卫东。: Jay is pinned on the sand with his hands tied behind him and a wad of coir in his mouth. Everyone turns to look at Wesley Zhao.
strings.阿旺被松开以后，一个人坐到了礁石后面，一直坐到天亮。: When they let him go, Jay sits alone behind the rocks until dawn.
strings.阿旺蹲在沙地上，一块一块把踢散的白珊瑚石捡了回去，摆得比原来还齐。: Jay squats in the sand and puts the scattered white coral back one piece at a time, neater than before.
strings.陆子昂上岸后的第一个电话打给了他父亲，第二个打给了海上搜救中心。他报的方位差了十: Ryan Lu's first call after landing was to his father, the second to the maritime rescue centre. The position he gave was a dozen-odd nautical miles off, but it was enough. Later he said in interviews that he had "found a way" to save everyone. No one contradicted him to his face.
strings.陆子昂会记住谁站在了他对面: Ryan Lu will remember who stood against him
strings.陆子昂又坐在椰子树荫下“安排工作”：谁去赶海，谁去捡柴，谁去瞭望。有人嘀咕：他上: Ryan Lu was back in the shade of a coconut palm, "assigning work": who gleans the shallows, who gathers firewood, who keeps watch. Someone muttered that since landing he had not once set foot on the reef flat.
strings.陆子昂回去以后，很快又成了那个出手大方、能说会道的陆总。只有喝多了的时候，他才会: Back home, Ryan Lu soon became the generous, smooth-talking Mr Lu again. Only when he had drunk too much would he suddenly ask whoever was beside him: "If there was only enough for one to live, how would you choose?" Before they could answer, he was laughing.
strings.陆子昂在岛上当了十二天以上的“管账的”。回去以后，他把这段经历讲成了一堂领导力课: On the island Ryan Lu spent more than twelve days as the one who kept the tally. Back home he turned the experience into a leadership lecture and taught it at a business school for years; the first slide was that plank, notched all over. No one in the audience knew the plank's count was one emergency kit short.
strings.陆子昂坐着那条黑船上了岸，第三天就回了家。他对来问话的警察说，“海燕号”上的其他: Ryan Lu went ashore on the black ship and was home on the third day. To the police who came to question him he said he had never seen the others from the Petrel again. The night the islanders were found, his father's lawyer flew to Haikou. The business was handled very quietly after that; only, Ryan Lu never went back to Sanya.
strings.陆子昂应急包里的红光火焰: A red flare from Ryan Lu's emergency kit
strings.陆子昂拿树枝在沙地上画了一张表：谁干了什么、干了多少、该分多少。他说这叫“激励机: Ryan Lu drew a table in the sand with a stick: who did what, how much of it, and what share each of them was owed. He called it an "incentive scheme". Chloe Su glanced at Ivy lying in the corner and said nothing.
strings.陆子昂接过只有半份的椰子肉，笑了一声：“行，我记住了。”: Ryan Lu took the half portion of coconut flesh and gave a short laugh: "Fine. I'll remember that."
strings.陆子昂的应急包里那两支红光火焰: The two red flares in Ryan Lu's emergency kit
strings.陆子昂的提议。干活的人会更卖力（每天多出一点吃的），但伤员和孩子会一天天饿瘦，怨: Ryan Lu's proposal. Those who work will work harder (a little more food each day), but the injured and the child will grow thin day by day, and the resentment will pile up.
strings.陆子昂的父亲后来包了一条船去岛上，想把儿子接回去。船员在北头礁岩的石缝里找到了一: Ryan Lu's father later chartered a boat to the island to bring his son home. The crew found a faded orange waterproof bag in a crack in the reef rock at the north end. His father had the coordinates of that unnamed island carved into the back of his son's headstone.
strings.陆子昂站在人群后面，跟着大家一起挥手，一直挥到那串灯光沉进海平线。: Ryan Lu stood behind the crowd, waving with the rest, waving until the string of lights sank below the horizon.
strings.陆子昂笑了笑，拍拍 {actor} 的肩膀，回去睡了。: Ryan Lu smiled, patted {actor} on the shoulder and went back to sleep.
strings.陆子昂第一个跳上了小艇，没有回头。: Ryan Lu was the first into the dinghy. He didn't look back.
strings.陆子昂被拽着去了椰林。他爬树的时候一直在笑，笑得人心里发毛。: Ryan Lu was dragged off to the palm grove. He laughed the whole way up the tree, a laugh that made the skin crawl.
strings.陆子昂被赶到了岛的南头，没有人知道他一个人是怎么熬过那些天的。来接人的船靠岸时，: Ryan Lu was driven to the south end of the island, and no one knew how he got through those days alone. When the rescue boat came in he was the first onto the dinghy, and the whole way he did not say a word to anyone.
strings.陆子昂跑回来时手里举着一支喷着红光的火焰，身后拖着那个橙色的应急包。所有人都愣住: Ryan Lu came running back with a flare hissing red in his hand and the orange emergency kit dragging behind him. Everyone froze.
strings.陆子昂跳上了小艇，回头冲大家挥了挥手。: Ryan Lu jumped into the dinghy and turned to wave to them all.
strings.降压药泡了海水，算啦，头晕就躺一下。: The blood-pressure pills got soaked in seawater. Never mind — if I get dizzy I will lie down.
strings.随他去，他会说话，也算出了力: Let him be — he talks well, and that counts for something
strings.隔这么远，几乎不可能被看见: At this distance, almost impossible to be seen
strings.集雨棚搭好了：一大片帆布斜挂在两棵椰子树之间，底下摆满了桶和椰子壳。下一场雨，能: The rain catcher is up: a broad sheet of canvas slung between two palms, with drums and coconut shells set out below. The next rain will bring several times as much water.
strings.雨水在沙子里：上面的，甜；下面的，咸。只舀上面。: Rainwater in the sand: the top is sweet, the bottom is salt. Skim only the top.
strings.雨水浮在海水上面，越往下越咸；要掌握分寸: Rainwater floats on the seawater, getting saltier the deeper you go; it takes a light hand
strings.雨水顺着帆布槽哗哗地流进桶里。等最后一个椰子壳也满了，大家才仰起头，张嘴接雨。: Rain pours down the canvas troughs into the barrels. Only when the last coconut shell is full do they tip their heads back and drink.
strings.雨水顺着窝棚的破口灌下来，浇灭了火堆。: Rain poured in through a tear in the shack and put the fire out.
strings.青椰在窝棚边堆成了一座小山，椰子树上只剩下够不着的那几串。: Green coconuts pile up into a small hill beside the shack; only the bunches nobody can reach are left on the trees.
strings.青烟、黑烟一股接一股地往上翻，像一根柱子立在岛的北头。: Grey and black smoke rolls up wave after wave, standing over the north end of the island like a pillar.
strings.韩振海在礁岩背后对 {actor} 承认了：那晚他喝了酒，在舵位上睡着了。: Behind the reef rock, Neil Han admitted to {actor} that he had been drinking that night and had fallen asleep at the helm.
strings.韩振海埋在了岛上。他脖子上那只不锈钢哨子被带回了三亚，挂在训练营关门前的最后一块: Neil Han is buried on the island. The stainless-steel whistle from around his neck was carried back to Sanya and hung on the last sign the training camp put up before it closed. Beside the sign is a line in his own hand: "At sea, the rules are the rules."
strings.韩振海接过手表，攥在手心里很久，最后戴上了。“我记。”他说。: Neil Han takes the watch and grips it a long while before he puts it on. “I'll keep the log,” he says.
strings.韩振海松开了手，一句话也没说。从那天起，没人再叫他“船长”。: Neil Han let go without a word. From that day on no one called him "the captain" again.
strings.韩振海活着回来了，可他没能把所有人都带回来。所有要签字的地方他都签了，所有能担的: Neil Han came home alive, but he did not bring everyone home. He signed every paper that wanted signing; he shouldered every responsibility he could. Only one thing he never told, to the day he died: what really happened at the helm that night.
strings.韩振海的肋骨可经不起: Neil Han's ribs can't take that
strings.韩振海站起来，挨个看了一遍所有人：“好。那从明天起，都听我的。”陆子昂耸了耸肩。: Neil Han stood up and looked them over one by one. "All right. From tomorrow, you all answer to me." Ryan Lu shrugged.
strings.韩振海被赶到岛的另一头以后，再也没有回到火堆边。来接人的船靠岸时，他坐在南头的礁: After Neil Han was driven to the far end of the island, he never came back to the fire. When the rescue boat came in he sat on the rocks at the south end and watched, and never stood up. In the end no one could say whether he boarded by himself or was helped aboard.
strings.风暴潮漫过了半个岛，好几棵椰子树连根倒下。塞进石缝里的水和存粮保住了。: The storm surge swept over half the island and several coconut palms went over roots and all. The water and food jammed into the rock cracks survived.
strings.飞机在空中慢慢转了一个大弯，朝小岛这边压低了高度，摇了摇机翼——他们看见了！: The plane made a slow, wide turn, dropped lower towards the island and rocked its wings — they had been seen!
strings.飞机突然掉头飞了回来——有人看见了镜面的反光！: The plane suddenly turned and came back — someone had caught the glint off a mirror!
strings.飞机转向了！它绕着小岛盘旋了两圈，投下了一个橙色的浮标。: The plane turned! It circled the island twice and dropped an orange buoy.
strings.饿着肚子，但所有人心里会好受一点: Empty bellies, but everyone feels a little better.
strings.马上就有水喝，但爬树的人可能摔下来: Water to drink at once, but whoever climbs may fall
strings.驾筏出海的人在外海漂了三天，被一条潭门渔船捞了起来。第二天，渔船按照他指的方向找: The man who took the raft out drifted on the open sea for three days before a Tanmen fishing boat picked him up. The next day the boat followed the direction he gave and found the island. Those who left alive: {survivors}. Those who did not live to see the day: {dead}. The broken raft was later towed back to port by the fishermen and lay on the quay for a long time.
strings.驾筏出海，葬身大海: Took the raft out to sea and drowned
strings.驾驶舱里的备用急救包: The spare first-aid kit from the cockpit
strings.骂声一直持续到天黑。谁也没说服谁。: The shouting goes on till dark. Nobody convinces anybody.
strings.高地上所有的柴一起点着，压上湿椰叶冒浓烟: Light every stick on the high ground and smother it with wet palm fronds for thick smoke
strings.高地上的信号柴堆垒好了，用椰叶盖着防雨。只要有火种，几分钟就能点着。: The signal stack is built on the high ground, roofed with palm fronds against the rain. Given an ember, it lights in minutes.
strings.高地上的柴堆轰地一下烧了起来，火苗蹿起一人多高。: The woodpile on the high ground went up with a roar, flames leaping a man's height.
strings.高地上的烟一连三天没断过。: The smoke on the high ground doesn't stop for three days.
strings.高地上的那堆夜火没柴了，熄了。: The night fire on the high ground has run out of wood and gone out.
strings.高地信号火堆: Signal fire on the high ground
strings.魅力十足、能言善辩、极度自信；习惯用利益和人情拉拢人，表面上讲道理、讲效率，骨子: Charming, articulate, supremely confident; he wins people over with favours and obligation, talking reason and efficiency while believing, at bottom, that the strongest decides; he never does the dirty work himself, but always finds a way to have someone else do it.
strings.鱼被切成大块，有火的时候烤，没火的时候就生着吃。这是好些天来最饱的一顿。: The fish was cut into thick slabs, grilled when there was fire and eaten raw when there was not. It was the fullest meal in days.
strings.鱼钩太粗，缝了三针就崩开了一针。伤口还敞着一道缝。: The hook was too thick; three stitches in, one pulled open. The wound still gaped.
strings.鸟群越大，渔船越可能往这边来: The bigger the flock, the likelier a fishing boat comes this way
strings.麦家旺，广西北海人，十六岁就上了船，在一条没有船名的“三无”铁壳船上当潜水工：嘴: Jay Mai, from Beihai in Guangxi, went to sea at sixteen, working as a diver on a "three-no" iron-hulled boat — unregistered, unlicensed, unmarked: a compressor hose gripped in his teeth, twenty metres down prying giant clams off the reef and gathering sea cucumbers. Prying one loose, he gashed his calf on the rock; the skipper decided he was a burden and dumped him on the island with a sack of rice.
strings.黏人、机灵、嘴馋；最喜欢小石头，见了海鸟就疯。: Clingy, clever, always hungry; Pebble is his favourite, and seabirds drive him wild.
strings.黑烟直直地升上天，可那个白点没有转向，慢慢消失在南边的云里。: The black smoke climbed straight up, but the white speck never turned and slowly vanished into the cloud in the south.
strings.黑船开走以后，沙滩上多了一个人：二十出头，又黑又瘦，小腿上一道发黑的口子已经肿了: After the black ship left, there was one more person on the beach: early twenties, dark and thin, a black-edged gash on his calf already swollen — cut on the reef rock while prying clams. The boat boss had thought him a burden and dumped him here with a bag of rice: "I'll come back for you next month." He was gripping a clam bar and watching you warily.
strings.（半夜突然站起来，竖着耳朵，冲着礁盘那边低吼）: (Stands up suddenly in the middle of the night, ears pricked, growling low towards the reef flat)
strings.（叼着一只还在乱爬的寄居蟹跑回来，放在小石头脚边，尾巴摇个不停）: (Comes running back with a hermit crab still scrambling in his mouth, sets it down at Pebble's feet, tail wagging without pause)
strings.（把空椰子壳舔得哗哗响，又抬起头看着你）: (Licks an empty coconut shell until it rattles, then lifts his head and looks at you)
strings.（趴在窝棚最阴凉的角落里，舌头伸得老长，肚子一鼓一鼓的）: (Flat on his belly in the coolest corner of the shack, tongue hanging out long, stomach rising and falling)
strings.（追着一群燕鸥冲上沙滩，扑了个空，打了个滚）: (Chases a flock of terns up the beach, catches nothing, tumbles head over heels)
strings.（锚仔突然冲着西北边的天空狂叫起来，叫得浑身的毛都竖着——好几秒钟以后，人才听见: (Anchor suddenly barks at the north-western sky, hackles up — it is several seconds before anyone hears the drone.)
